messages:
maria (CSM): Kicking off CoveTech onboarding — want to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a compact timeline. Proposed 3-week ramp. @sam @kevin @ryan please confirm owner areas and any hard blockers (EU data, infra lead time, contract items).

Elaine (CoveTech): Thanks Maria — Elaine here. Primary goals: 1) search assistant in product with embeddings refreshed daily, 2) generation API for support snippets with consistent latency, and 3) data residency in EU. Happy to share sample traffic & prompt sets.

sam (Solutions Eng): I can lead SDK/integration and the live demo. Need a sample qps profile + example corpus. Any preferred embedding dimension or similarity library?

kevin (Platform): Heads up — EU private deployment implies VPC + dedicated pool. Environment provisioning ~10 business days after we have network details + contract. If they need faster, we can discuss hosted with IP allowlist but that may not satisfy residency.

ryan (RevOps): I'll update the billing profile and mark this as high-touch for renewal tracking. Maria — do we have an expected committed spend or 'T-shirt' size?

maria (CSM): Success criteria draft:
- Production-ready API integration to sandbox with sample dataset
- Embedding refresh pipeline automated and verified (daily)
- Generation p50 under 250ms on our recommended model for supported prompt shapes

Timeline (proposed):
Week 0: kickoff, access + keys, network intake
Week 1: environment provisioning (EU), SDK integration start
Week 2: ingest & embedding pipeline, automated tests
Week 3: perf tuning, handoff, enablement + knowledge transfer

Known risks: EU data residency requirement, model onboarding latency if custom models needed, higher qps than anticipated. Mitigations: early infra intake, temporary hosted fallback, prompt-caching config.

maria (CSM): Proposing kickoff call Thu 10:00 PT — agenda: stakeholders intro, share sample payloads, infra intake steps, assign owners.

Elaine (CoveTech): Thu 10 works for us.

sam (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare an SDK demo and a short integration snippet. Example curl to sanity-check keys:
```
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"model":"small-gen","prompt":"hello"}'
```

onboarding-bot: Calendar event created: CoveTech Onboarding Kickoff — Thu 10:00 PT (link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/conv123)

maria (CSM): Assigning owners: @sam -> SDK + demo, @kevin -> infra & VPC intake, @ryan -> billing + contract coordination. I'll post the enablement deck and the initial prompt set by EOD.

sam (Solutions Eng): Noted — will also prepare a 10-point eval checklist for tracking quality/regressions during tuning.

maria (CSM): Thanks team. Linking intake form + placeholder docs: https://redwood.docs/onboarding/covetech (will replace with real links after intake). :thumbsup:
